review_findings: Five fields have explicit reads, read-modify-write calls, or post-write readback examples in the reviewed source set; this does not certify read side effects in JA OS firmware state.
REG_SET with a supplied initial value is not a read example; generic_reg_set_ex and generic_reg_update_ex have different access behavior.
DCE11.2 hardware sequencing includes controller-specific display power gating; PCI D0 does not establish the chosen display-pipe power/clock state.
Primary-surface low writes trigger an update in the reviewed page-flip path; no write to the capture fields is permitted.
Do not blindly probe all six pipes or infer the active pipe from GOP address/geometry.
BAR5 operation retention requires stable binding/token identities, permanent close-before-drain, and retained mapping/assignment pins until all CPU holds return.

The explicit read-only bring-up experiment narrows discovery to six CRTC_CONTROL queries, as inspected in dce_v11_0_is_display_hung; only a uniquely requested-and-current running pipe may supply the thirty-field capture. Its firmware-state assumptions remain provisional until hardware evidence.

ARRAY_LINEAR_ALIGNED=1 is a linear layout. The first physical profile1 sample reported GRPH_CONTROL=0x0a10800a, GPU primary=0xf400000000, pitch1024 and extent1024x768; its raw evidence is retained separately. Bank/pipe metadata does not enter the linear offset calculation; this is no permission to reuse VRAM.

The proposed address-rebind recipe follows high-before-low and post-read ordering from the pinned page-flip path. Programming policy is Ring3; scalar preview validation executes no MMIO and proves neither scanout completion nor recovery.

Measured profile3 update0,flip control0x20,frames0x2102..0x211a; v15 zero-control preflight refused as designed. The audited0x20 field is pending-mode; dce_v11_0_page_flip preserves it via RMW of immediate enable. Stable0x20 is accepted by the subsequent data-only preview; no physical completion semantics or GPU write grant is inferred.
